Reading Comprehension
Read the text and answer the questions
📖 Julia and Marco — A New Passion

Julia and Marco have been friends for a long time. Last month, Marco decided to learn how to cook. He has been practicing for a while now, and he is getting really good at it.

Last weekend, they went to a neighborhood festival together. There were fireworks everywhere and the atmosphere was amazing. Marco told Julia he had been cooking a lot lately — he had already learned how to grill steak, fry potatoes, chop vegetables, and even bake a cake.

When Julia tasted the food Marco had prepared at the festival, she said it smelled amazing and tasted like something from a restaurant. "No way!" she said, surprised. "Did you really make all of this by yourself?"

Marco smiled and promised Julia he would bake a cake for her birthday party next week. He said he would also grill the meat for all the guests. Julia laughed and said: "It's about time you showed everyone your cooking skills! So far so good, Marco. I'm proud of you."
